name: json2dir-cs
description: The whole tool as a single C# expression
build:
export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1
# Ubuntu's dotnet has no apphost for its distro RID; the tool runs through `dotnet json2dir.dll` anyway.
dotnet build -c Release --nologo -v quiet -p:UseAppHost=false json2dir
